method: Actual production drawWorld at 960×540 logical coordinates, 1920×1080 backing. Camera/party-position and cleared-encounter fixtures isolate existing sign locations; no earned-progression claim. Sign objects and domestic furniture are not mutated.

captures.name: The southern branch
captures.dialogue: South: Forest Veil. Follow the old watercourse beneath the trees.

covered.name: The old coast road
covered.dialogue: Haventide → • the pier bell has fallen silent. The sea road continues east.

covered.name: The southern branch
covered.dialogue: South: Forest Veil. Follow the old watercourse beneath the trees.

covered.name: The furnace road
covered.dialogue: North: Crater Ember. Heat shields and an Ascendant settlement are required.

covered.name: The reed road
covered.dialogue: Mire Bog →. Its archive sleeps beneath the black water.

covered.name: The low-water marker
covered.dialogue: The archive keeper binds the marsh. Interrupt its gathering roots before they close.

covered.name: A melted warning
covered.dialogue: When the sovereign opens its furnace, guard. The next breath carries the mountain.

covered.name: The rescue road
covered.dialogue: Frost Canyon ↑. Rune knows the old rescue marks.

covered.name: A sentinel’s field note
covered.dialogue: The colossus gathers its storm in plain sight. Brace together when its heart turns white.

covered.name: The last threshold
covered.dialogue: Beyond this threshold waits the one who made the silence. Bring the four living seals, the memory of the Crown, and a Transcendent settlement.
